reason: I get my leads from posting and comment-to-DM, and I only cold DM when the pipeline's thin. If my pipeline's thin, it's usually my offer or my content, not that I'm not sending enough DMs. I'm not putting a card down on a new tool for a problem I don't really have.
objection: No results from anyone yet, 7 seats taken, and it's another cold-DM tool. Instagram already throttles accounts, and I'm not risking my main account on something nobody has proof for. $147 a month is $147 I'd rather put into content.
would_change_my_mind: A few agency owners at my size showing real booked calls from it, with screenshots, and some clear proof that the account doesn't get flagged. A free trial that doesn't need a card would also get me to look.
